title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-mbm7: fuzz harness calls Fragment::from_bytes with wrong arity
description: In commit d82daa6bd3, `rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs` was changed from `Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile)` to `Fragment::from_bytes(data)`, removing the required second argument. However, `Fragment::from_bytes` (at fragment.rs:175) still has signature `pub fn from_bytes(data: &[u8], out: &'a mut [u8]) -> Result<Self, FragmentError>` — it takes two arguments, not one. This will cause a compilation error in the fuzz target, breaking fuzz testing entirely. The function was confused with `Ack::from_bytes` which does take a single argument (fragment.rs:272). Fix: revert the line to pass a tile buffer, e.g., `let mut tile = [0u8; TILE_SIZE]; let _ = Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile);`.
